title: Europa IC 12
bookshelves: Category: Biography, Literature and Literary studies
summary: How do you interact with people who don’t speak your language? Easy! You speak your language and they speak theirs, using specific communication strategies and shared vocabulary. With its expressly-scripted plurilingual videos, Europa IC 12 trains you to effectively negotiate a conversation with speakers of different European languages. At the same time, its videos, audios, readings and exercises, train you to understand – at an A2 level – twelve languages: six Romance and six Germanic ones.
